name: Balance Billing Protection (No Surprises Act) Agent
description: Balance Billing Protection (No Surprises Act) Agent — a governed Pause fabric agent (agentforce, A2A). Governance tier: payer-operations. Enforces 4 Pause Agent Fabric policies. Prototype agent card — synthetic data, no real PHI.

skills.name: Decides whether the No Surprises Act prohibits balance-bi...
skills.description: Decides whether the No Surprises Act prohibits balance-billing an out-of-network claim — resolves the protection basis (emergency, out-of-network at an in-network facility, air ambulance, ground ambulance, in-network), applies any effective notice-and-consent waiver (valid only for a waivable, non-ancillary service), computes the patient's cost-share BASIS (in-network QPA for a protected claim), and computes the balance-bill amount (0 + prohibited for a protected claim). A deterministic payer-plane agent; the claim-time complement to the Good Faith Estimate agent

skills.name: The determination is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of t...
skills.description: The determination is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the request + the basis catalog (no randomness, no clock); the same claim always yields the same protection + cost-share basis + balance-bill flags

skills.name: Every determination must cite a recorded protection basis...
skills.description: Every determination must cite a recorded protection basis — an ad-hoc / un-sourced protection call is blocked at the Agent Fabric governance boundary (policy.balancebill.protection-basis-sourced); and for a PROTECTED claim the patient's cost-share must be computed on the in-network (QPA) basis, never the out-of-network billed charge — a protected patient's cost-share based on the billed charge over-charges them and is blocked (policy.balancebill.cost-share-in-network-basis, 45 CFR 149.110–149.130). Mirrors the Overpayment & Recovery Agent's reason-catalog-sourced + within-lookback-window posture

skills.name: A PROTECTED claim can NEVER be balance-billed — the diffe...
skills.description: A PROTECTED claim can NEVER be balance-billed — the difference between the billed charge and the allowed amount may not be billed to the patient, and a balance bill allowed on a protected claim is blocked (policy.balancebill.no-autonomous-balance-bill); a permitted balance bill on a NON-protected claim (a valid waiver, ground ambulance) requires human review. Mirrors the Overpayment & Recovery Agent's no-autonomous-clawback and the Lab Result Agent's no-autonomous-clinical-action posture

skills.name: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic protection bases + wa...
skills.description: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic protection bases + waiver rules + ancillary handling + QPA amounts — clearly labeled; NOT a certified No Surprises Act engine (a real determination uses the actual Qualifying Payment Amount, the federal IDR process, the notice-and-consent requirements, and the provider's network contracts under 45 CFR 149)
